title: Estimate single-cell fate with CellRank and real-time optimal transport
description: Direct Codex to construct separately reviewable pseudotime or moscot real-time transition kernels, estimate GPCCA fate probabilities toward declared terminal states, retain lineage-driver statistics, validate stochasticity and direction against experimental time, and preserve every source cell and raw count.
intents: 单细胞命运概率 最优传输 CellRank moscot
questions: Which terminal fates are probabilistically supported for each cell, and are those conclusions stable to a pseudotime-directed versus experimental-time optimal-transport transition model?
preconditions: The H5AD has immutable integer-like raw counts, unique cells and features, multiple biological samples, at least three ordered experimental times, a precomputed independent pseudotime, at least two evidence-backed terminal states, and new output paths.
assumptions: Fate probabilities describe transitions under the selected kernel and terminal-state definition; they do not prove clonal ancestry, and pseudotime and real-time optimal transport remain separate sensitivity models.

quality_gates.description: Block guessed count, sample, time, pseudotime, terminal-state, feature, or source-object semantics.
Every kernel transition row and every fate-probability row must be finite, nonnegative, cell-aligned, and sum to one within tolerance.
Terminal states require predeclared independent evidence and adequate cells; their own-fate probabilities must pass the frozen threshold.
Expected transition direction must agree with withheld pseudotime and experimental time; a directed graph alone is insufficient.
Pseudotime and moscot optimal-transport kernels remain separately parameterized and reported; disagreement is sensitivity evidence.
Reload H5AD, transition matrix, fate table, driver table, source counts, identities, parameters, versions, and quality status.

version_differences.description: Kernel construction, GPCCA terminal-state assignment, fate probabilities, and lineage-driver fields are release-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Detect the release, validate transition and fate stochasticity, and reload all fields before widening support.

version_differences.description: TemporalProblem preparation, OTT solver arguments, transport outputs, and RealTimeKernel conversion are release-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Record time policy, representation, epsilon, convergence and coupling pairs and verify direction.

limitations: Validated execution covers a three-time-point bifurcation with two declared terminal states using CellRank 2.3.2 PseudotimeKernel and moscot 0.5.1 TemporalProblem through RealTimeKernel. Fate probabilities depend on kernel, neighborhood, time sampling, and terminal definitions and do not establish clonal ancestry or condition-level inference. Environment and compute-resource management remain outside plugin scope.

concept_sources: Project-owned fate workflow separating pseudotime and experimental-time optimal-transport kernels.

template_sections.purpose: Establish count, sample, time, pseudotime and terminal-state evidence.
required_logic: Inspect immutable counts, samples, ordered time, pseudotime provenance, terminal evidence, feature namespace, cell accounting and source digest.
Freeze neighborhood, kernel mode, optimal-transport regularization, terminal cells and quality thresholds before execution.

template_sections.purpose: Execute separate transition kernels and GPCCA fate estimation.
required_logic: Build a pseudotime kernel or solve adjacent moscot temporal couplings and convert them to a RealTimeKernel.
Require row-stochastic transitions, assign declared terminal cells, compute fate probabilities without PETSc dependence, and retain lineage-driver statistics.

template_sections.purpose: Check direction, terminal recovery, source preservation and serialization.
required_logic: Test expected experimental-time and pseudotime transition deltas and terminal own-fate probabilities.
Reload H5AD and evidence tables and reconcile every cell, count, transition, fate, driver, parameter and version.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Use pseudotime for a validated continuous ordering and moscot for observed time-point transport; run both as sensitivity models when justified.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Never average kernel outputs or conceal disagreement.

preflight_checks: Inspect actual object, counts, samples, time, pseudotime, terminal-state cells, neighbors, source digest and output paths.
Detect exact CellRank, moscot, Scanpy, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, JAX, OTT-JAX and Python versions in an existing runtime.
postflight_checks: Recompute transition and fate row sums, expected time direction and terminal own-fate support.
Reload all objects and tables and preserve method-specific outputs and source counts.
forbidden_actions: Do not manage Python, R, Conda, containers, CPU, GPU, Slurm, remote, or local-model infrastructure.
Do not guess terminal states, tune kernels to desired fates, combine incompatible kernels, or claim fate probabilities prove ancestry.
Do not overwrite source counts or report generated or unreloaded outputs as evidence.
